name: Vector Arena
description: A math holodeck where your two hands ARE the endpoints of a vector. Hold the LEFT trigger to plant point A at your left hand, the RIGHT trigger to plant point B at your right hand, and a glowing arrow A->B draws between them with the live arithmetic floating beside it: AB = B - A, |AB|, and the unit direction, all recomputed as your hands move. Charge with the RIGHT grip and pull the RIGHT trigger to FIRE a RigidBody3D ball from A whose launch velocity IS the vector scaled by force_gain — wider hands throw harder. A labeled wall with a visible unit normal reflects fired balls by the literal formula r = d - 2(d.n)n, flashing a panel that shows d.n, 2(d.n)n, r, and the |r| = |d| invariant. On desktop or headless, with no controllers found, two demo points orbit slowly and auto-fire so the arena always shows live vector math.
theoreticalGrounding: A vector is the difference between two points: AB = B - A. Its direction is AB / |AB| and its magnitude |AB| is the distance between the hands. Treated as a force, the same arrow becomes a launch velocity v = AB * force_gain, so subtraction, direction, magnitude, and force are one object seen from different sides. Reflection across a plane with unit normal n is r = d - 2(d.n)n, which removes twice the normal component and preserves length, so |r| = |d|. The artifact makes each of these the felt consequence of moving two hands.

vector_arena.name: Vector Arena
vector_arena.description: Two-handed vector playground: LEFT trigger places point A at the left hand, RIGHT trigger places point B at the right hand, and a live green arrow A->B carries its own billboarded readout (AB = B - A, |AB|, dir). RIGHT grip charges the arrow; RIGHT trigger while charged fires a RigidBody3D ball from A with velocity = AB * force_gain, leaving a faded ghost of the intended vector for intent-vs-result comparison. A labeled wall shows its unit normal n-hat as an arrow; fired balls reflect off it by the formula r = d - 2(d.n)n (not engine bounce), flashing a panel with the full arithmetic and the |r| = |d| check. Degrades gracefully on desktop/headless to two orbiting demo points with periodic auto-fire.
vector_arena.qfep_connection: F_force: a vector is the difference between two points, and once you can hold both points you can hold the difference. The gap between your hands becomes a direction, a magnitude, and a force in one gesture; the wall answers with reflection, which changes the arrow's heading while keeping its length — what you give is reshaped, never lost.
